tei:div.tei:p: #!"#༄༅: dam chos sprul sku snying thig las: bdud mgon legs grub rdo rje'i sngags byang zab mo bzhugs so:

ྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ shrī he ru ka la 'dud: bdag 'dra padma bdud 'dul gyis: bdud mgon legs grub rdo rje yi: sngags byang zab mo gser srang brgya yi bka' rgya can: yang gsang snying gi thig le 'di: nga sprul snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: oṃ tri shrī badzra ma hā kā la seng hā mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dza: ḍā ki nī si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dza: dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri hūm̐ phaṭa: dza dza: 'di nyid rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'o: ྈྈྈ oṃ shrī tri ma hā kā la seng ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring hūm̐ phaṭa: ḍā ki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza: de nas 'bod sngags zab mo ni/ dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri: hūm̐ tri hring dza: ma hā kā la seng ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dza: e a mu kaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad sod sod: thum ril: si na ra ma tiṣṭha tiṣṭha tri hring dza: e a mu kaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya bhyo: dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri e thum rbud: ma rā ya sod sod: ྈྈྈ de nas rbad sngags ni: tri ma hā kā la sing ha mu kha hā hūm̐ phaṭa: tri hring dza: e sa ma ya nṛ rbad snying la rbud: bhyo sod: tri si na ra ma tiṣṭha tiṣṭha tri hring dza: ma ma ru lu ru lu dgra bo'i snying la khaṃ rmug rbad sod sod: tir ti ka thā: tsitta la rbad sod: dbugs chod thum ril rbad sod: a mu kaṃ nṛ thum dza sod: seng ha ra tsa rbad sod: ru tra du mā ra ya nṛ rbad sod: dhi tri ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri nṛ rmug rbud rbad sod: dgra bo che ge mo rmug rbad sod: yuṃ chod kha thum ril rbad sod: 'jib gtor raṃ rbad sod: mā ra ya rmug rbad sod: a mu kaṃ dgra bo'i tsitta la breng breng rbad sod: dbugs las rngub rngub thum ril rbad sod: bsad sngags ni: srog rtsa la thum ril myog myog bhyo bhyo: nṛ hur thum mā ra ya rbad sod rbad sod: hur thuṃ dza: de nas bla 'gug gi sngags ni: bla 'gug dus bdun:

'gugs 'dren gyi gong du nyer gcig bzlas so: dgra bo che ge mo 'i bla sha re ma ti 'grims 'grims: sha ma ri ti thul thul myog myog yed yed: sha ling myog ling: kug ling phum ling: myog myog: yed yed: khug khug: dzaḥdza: 'di nyid sngags byang zab pa'i mthur thug go: skal ldan re la gcig brgyud ma gtogs mang du ma spel: tsitta dha thim: a dam rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dha dha dha: 1$0000230chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rjes tsha ba sgro brag nas gdan drangs pa/ ka gnam chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du shog ser las phab pa'o// dgra srog dmar po myur du len par shog ༈ /1$0000300 dzap bzlas ni/ rang nyid zhing skyong du gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ge sgra sgrog snying khar rdo rje khro lod/ de'i snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsam: g.yon du yum gyi thugs kar tri dmar po bsam: yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ tri gnyis las sngags kyi 'od zer spu gri lta bur 'phros: yab yum dregs pa sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i dmag tshogs kyis mngon spyod drag po'i las ci bcol ba rnams bsgrub par bsam: yi dam ltar du'o// oṃ tri shrī badzra ma hā kā la seng ha mu kha sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ dza dza: ma hā kā la si na ra ra ma sidhi pha la hūm̐ dza tri hring dza:
